stepwell-table-after3.see: A high-angle view of a square sand tile on a tabletop grid featuring a central sunken stepwell filled with green water and surrounded by three small stands of clay pots.
stepwell-table-after3.wrong: A stretched and distorted wall fragment clipping onto the sand surface on the left, along with photogrammetry distortion around the pit edges.

stepwell-low-after3.see: An angled view looking into the sunken stepwell showing two tiers of arched stone galleries along the back wall, stone steps descending to green water, and pottery stands on the surrounding sand.
stepwell-low-after3.wrong: A severely warped and stretched wall fragment along the right edge clipping through the ground, with photogrammetry mesh distortion around the pit.
